posts.author: lukilemon
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I'm currently using
YossayaADJPlugin_MV.js
(version 1.6.3) in RPG Maker MV, and I'm trying to apply a
white stroke effect
around a character using the plugin's filter feature.
As you can see, I've applied the filter exactly as described in the guide, but unfortunately, the effect doesn't show up in-game. I'm not sure if I'm missing something, or if there's a compatibility issue I'm unaware of.
Has anyone else encountered this issue or found a workaround? I'd really appreciate any advice or insight you might have.
I’ve contacted the plugin’s creator about this issue, but since I’m not sure if or when I’ll receive a response, I’m carefully reaching out here as well for any help.
Thanks in advance for your help!

posts.author: Sword_of_Dusk
posts.body: You would greatly increase your chances of getting help if you link the plugin in question. This goes double for any non-English plugin that isn't from a commonly cited dev like Moghunter.
